yd:
Ask Claude something very simple and you get two to three pages of text back. Anthropic shipped a fix called Output Styles: you tell your AI how you like your responses, and it comes with a new mode called Concise.

How to turn it on: go into your settings and set your output style to Concise. Your AI agent will then always reply in a very short format that is easier to understand.
